payload.text:
NEWSROOM BRIEF

A steady federal funds median, a changing pattern of trading

A flat federal funds median did not mean unchanged trading: the New York Fed's September 17-October 22, 2026 data show changing rate percentiles and volume.

What to watch: The next useful observation is whether the median moves within or outside the target range reported for the same date, and whether a change in the transaction-rate percentiles persists across several business days.

Full brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/pending-publication-fe4afe86931bd7e2

Why it matters: A median can stay fixed while transactions away from its center change price.

Context: The strongest countercase to reading these variations as a warning is the steady median itself: EFFR remained within the reported policy target on every observed date.
